Chapter 691: Chapter 3: The Endless Cycle of Life and Death (Subscribe Please)_2

“This way, can you still not care?”

The Sizhong Ancient God spoke.

Years ago, the phenomenon that triggered the Chaos Void Origin Infusion was revealed by the supreme beings of the Different Species, and even the Ancient Gods learned that it originated from Human Civilization.

Afterwards, Human Civilization also made public that a seclusive Tenth Rank Evolver had broken through to the Eleventh Rank.

It matched the conjectures of the supreme beings from the Different Species.

“A Tenth Rank understanding the Rule of Time…” Tuoba Ancient God fell into silence.

...

The Galaxy Master could be indifferent, after all, even a transcendent talent has little direct help in impacting the ultimate.

But a Tenth Rank understanding the Rule of Time? This indeed provides no small benefit to the ultimate, allowing one to endure the Chaos Void Origin Infusion another time more than a normal Eleventh Rank Peak powerhouse.

The Inner World would gain great benefits; in the future, the Ultimate Leap towards transforming into an Inner Universe would also be much easier.

“It doesn’t affect me either,” Tuoba Ancient God gave Sizhong Ancient God a glance, “Even if Human Civilization has one more Supreme Being, it’s just a shift in the dynamic among the major peak powers, at worst I’ll join the Insect Race.”

The emergence of another Supreme Being in Human Civilization only enhances the foundation and strength of Human Civilization, far from being brazen.

“You plan to attack the ultimate within ten million years, and during that time, joining the Insect Race, really has no impact at all?” Sizhong Ancient God said with a smile.

Tuoba Ancient God did not reply.

At this moment, he also faintly regretted, how could he have anticipated that the Galaxy Master would be so unthreatened?

And Human Civilization’s foundation is too terrifying; how long has it been since it birthed nine Supreme Beings, and now there is hope for the birth of a tenth?

Had he known this, decisively handing over that friend of the Milky Way Main Star would indeed have been the best choice.

At least not to offend the Milky Way Main Star to death, nor to offend Human Civilization to death.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

“Teacher has stepped into the Ninth Rank?” Lin Yuan received the news, a smile emerging on his face.

Although stepping into the Ninth Rank is trivial for the current Lin Yuan, for Chikun Star Lord, it was a many years’ wish.

“Go congratulate Teacher.”

Lin Yuan connected his consciousness to the Virtual World.

…

Personal space.

Lin Yuan and Chikun Star Lord sat facing each other.

“Congratulations, Teacher, on stepping into the Ninth Rank.” Lin Yuan said with a smile.

“Are you making fun of me?” Chikun Star Lord rolled his eyes—he hadn’t even mentioned Lin Yuan breaking through to the Tenth Rank yet.

In comparison to the birth of a Tenth Rank Evolver, what is a break from the Eighth to the Ninth Rank?

Afterwards, the master and disciple chatted casually for a while.

Chikun Star Lord could feel that, even though his disciple had completely surpassed him, he did not display any airs of a Tenth Rank Evolver; he was still like the junior disciple from years past.

This warmed Chikun Star Lord’s heart a bit.

“By the way, between the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path and the Xuanhuang Secret Realm…” Chikun Star Lord tentatively asked.

He was quite curious about the relationship between the two.

“This exploration of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm did not reveal any connection with the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path…” Lin Yuan did not tell the whole truth.

Primarily because the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was too important; perhaps when Lin Yuan becomes a Supreme Being without fear of anything, he might disclose this matter.

But for now?

It’s better to keep it under wraps.

“There’s no connection at all?” Chikun Star Lord felt somewhat disappointed, “Right, what could a evolutionary path that even I could obtain count for against the Xuanhuang Secret Realm?”

Chikun Star Lord quickly figured it out.

Obtaining the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path was not very difficult for him.

If the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path really had a key connection with the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, how could it possibly have surfaced through him, a mere Eighth Rank powerhouse?

What Chikun Star Lord did not know was that the Spirit of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, in order to better disseminate the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path to the outside world, almost gave away the evolutionary path.

However, most powerhouses, upon obtaining this evolutionary path, try repeatedly and find it absolutely unfeasible to cultivate, and so gradually give up and no longer pay attention.

Occasionally life forms that meet the requirements of the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path appear and they too often perish midway, failing to reach the prerequisites necessary to call upon the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

“Teacher, about the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path, I intend to make it public, and find a few Evolvers within my Human Civilization who can cultivate this evolutionary path.” Lin Yuan pondered for a while, then spoke.

This was also what he had promised to the Spirit of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

As for other Evolvers cultivating the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path, would it shake Lin Yuan’s control over the Xuanhuang Secret Realm?

That possibility no longer existed, as in today’s scenario, Lin Yuan had refined the Core of the Secret Realm, becoming the undisputed master of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, even if someone cultivated the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path to the Tenth, Eleventh Rank, it would not affect the Xuanhuang Secret Realm in the slightest.

“No problem.” Chikun Star Lord nodded.

“Thank you, Teacher,” Lin Yuan immediately said.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan successfully uploaded the First Tier Chapter to the Seventh Rank Chapter of the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path.

As for the Eighth Layer Part, Ninth Rank Chapter, Tenth Rank Chapter, Eleventh Stage Volume, and even the Twelfth-stage Chapter? If one can’t even get through the initial First Tier Chapter to the Seventh Rank Chapter, there’s naturally no need to cultivate the later stages.

“The three goddesses don’t think highly of the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path…” Lin Yuan received the evaluation from the Goddess of Wisdom on the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path.

The most important criterion for evaluating evolutionary paths in Human Civilization is their level of adoption.

That is, the number of people who can cultivate this evolutionary path.

Even if it’s a Supreme Evolution Path, if the threshold is extremely high, resulting in no one being able to enter, then its value won’t be very high either.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm might not be such that no one can enter, but cultivating this evolutionary path is not an easy matter.

…
